verdict.rationale: The Uptime API is served under a versioned path (/api/v2/monitors), which shows Better Stack versions its API. The evidence contains no documented versioning scheme, deprecation policy, sunset timelines or changelog. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit API versioning documentation, sunset/migration notice process, changelog, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
